Hi Mateo —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement here would like a concise mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out legal / IT security gating so we can track to our purchasing committee on 9/23. Two asks from our side to validate timeline: 

1) Confirmation of which artifacts you can provide immediately for SOC2 / data residency (we flagged the SOC2 Type II, encryption notes, and retention controls).
2) A proposed sequencing for MSA / DPA / order form so procurement knows what must be signed before we run any pilot or ingest PHI.

Can you share a MAP that calls out milestone owners and the earliest feasible dates for each gate?

Best,
Elaine Park

Veridian Health

Thanks — attaching a draft MAP and an evidence index for SOC2 items. High level sequencing proposal below (owners noted):

- Week 1 (9/13) — Security evidence exchange & Q&A (Owner: Security/Ops; contact: Karthik Iyer)

Attachments: MAP-draft-VD-v1.2.xlsx, evidence-index-soc2.pdf, orderform-template-redwood.docx

Next step: can we lock a 30-minute sync on Thursday to walk procurement + legal through the MAP and the gating assumptions? I can include Karthik and Vanessa on that call.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez

Looping in some legal sequencing notes — forwarding my quick read of Mateo's MAP.

Key legal gating items to call out explicitly in the MAP:
- Baseline MSA (commercial terms) can be agreed in parallel with procurement redlines but must be signed before creating a production tenant.
- DPA (data handling + PHI language) must be signed before any PHI is allowed in their pilot environment; we can grant a sandbox without PHI earlier if desired.
- Order form must reference the exact model tier and dedicated capacity commitments; pricing/term approvals often block procurement when these are placeholders.

Operational constraint: If Veridian requires an HSM/KMS integration (customer-managed keys), that adds a 3-4 week ops lead time and should be surfaced now.

I'll be on the call Thursday; I can bring a redline checklist and a minimal clause set to speed up review.

—Vanessa
Head of Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
